9.copy:
The phones don't stop at 5 p.m., but your team does, and they deserve to.

Every call that rolls to voicemail after hours sends that patient one of two ways, and most of them do not try again tomorrow. They book with whichever practice picked up the phone instead.

PS | Lexi answers on the first ring, around the clock and during the peak hours when your front desk can't get to every line. It handles sinus, allergy and balloon procedure calls, insurance verification and scheduling, and books directly into your EMR. Your team walks in to appointments already on the books, with insurance verified.

Make PS | Lexi part of your team.
